releases.displayName: FREE UPDATE: Try out the new "Study Mode"!

items.text: Hello all planet builders!
Thanks for continuing to play Bubblegum Galaxy, we're so happy to see people still enjoying the game.
Today, we're sharing a new update with you, that besides bug fixes includes a new free special mode for the game!
Ever feel like you need a co-working companion? Look no more: Haco is here!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514242/620c584042ed1514bfabe108928180ca6561638a.png"]

In Study Mode, Haco will join you while she's working on a planet to keep you company. While in this mode, you can use the built-in music player to listen to game's HQ soundtrack and set a Pomodoro-style timer to set focus while you work.

Study Mode can be accessed from the Main Menu. You can use it in full screen or in windowed mode; if windowed, you can resize the window and pin it to the top so you can use other applications while running a timer!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42514242/66a924336aaacfd3569ae743078a55ca23341025.png"]

When loading into Study Mode, the game will also load the office decorations and costume you have set in the main game. If you want to customize the appearance of Haco or her cubicle, you must load the main game, customize your office, and then exit back to the main menu.

Note: You can also access Study Mode from Haco's computer if you've finished the game, but this will have lower performance than loading it from the menu - we recommend using the main menu option if you're planning to do other activities on your computer!
We've implemented a potential fix for when tile placement breaks and you are no longer able to place tiles. If you are still running into issues, please let us know on Discord!
We've fixed an issue when obtaining friendship related achievements.

We've added a fix for achievements that were unlocked in-game but not on Steam: if there is any achievement you unlocked in-game but not on Steam, open the journal on Haco's computer and navigate to the corresponding achievement. This should unlock the achievement, but let us know if it doesn't work!
Fixed issue where music volume options was ignored during planet building gameplay.
Removed soft bubblegummy limit when building larger planets. We hope the grind for the bubblegummy achievement is tad more bearable now!
As always, thanks for your support. Let us know if you run into any issues, and we hope you enjoy this update!
-Smarto Club & Astrolabe Games
Hello Bubblegum interns!

We've uploaded a quick hotfix to resolve issues players were encountering with negative gift cards. We've also implemented some typo fixes and optimizations that should make the game more stable on larger planets.
Keep on rebuilding the galaxy,
-Smarto Club & Astrolabe Games

Hello all planet builders!
We've just uploaded a hot fix to the game that fixes high-priority bugs with the endless mode unlocked after completing the game, plus some other bugs with the store and gameplay.
Thanks for all the feedback you've shared so far! We're glad to hear you're enjoying the game, and we're looking into what feedback we can address in a patch in the near future.
Until then, keep on building~
-Smarto Club Team
Hello everyone! Hope you all have been well. We were super happy with the reception to demo and are so glad that people are enjoying the game. Your feedback and comments keeps up motivated!
While we've spent the last month focusing the business side of making games, we've also been reading your feedback and slowly implementing it into the game, and we just released a small patch!

We've been focusing on bug fixes and quality-of-life changes so there is no new gameplay content in this update, as we're currently aiming to improve the experience for new people who find the demo (or for those of you want to replay the demo as it is!). We hope to share an update with new levels and story events in the near future.

Here's a changelog for the patch, and a preview of some features we're working on for the next demo update. As usual, we'd love to hear any comments you have on the game! You can reach us on Discord or on the Steam Forums.
Tweaked default volume for main menu music.
Increased default speed for dialogue.
Text animation now instantly finishes if advance button is pressed while text is being shown. Rejoice speed readers!
Changed default rotation direction for planet building camera. There will be an option to invert it once we add the options menu!
Increased maximum zoom out level for planet building.
Camera can also now be rotated in the office using the mouse.
Tiles can now be unselected with Z or the middle mouse button. (They originally could only be unselected with the right mouse button, but that interfered with mouse camera rotation).
Default camera speed for planet construction is a bit faster. You can also hold shift to move the camera faster while move the camera with keyboard controls.

Character dialogue during planet building NO longer defaults to auto-advance. Dialogue must be manually advanced by pressing the space bar or by clicking on the text bubble (except when it's a tutorial dialogue).
Implemented partial fix for when a level started with no stars in the background.

Rewrote object highlight code which improves performance and possibly fixes the issue where some objects would disappear/become transparent, but not 100% sure it does. Please let us know if you see any disappearing mountains or trees!
Made tile rotation code more robust, so hopefully no more funny business in tile rotation (but who knows, these tiles like being funny).
Added a "skip tutorial" button to skip the dialogue at the start of many planet building levels.
While this isn't an extensive list, here's some of the features we're working on for next updates:
Options menu: This will include options such as controller remapping and volume controls.
Game Saving: No need to finish all the levels in one sitting anymore!
Planet saving: For when you need a break from placing tiles, you will be able to pause planet construction, take a stroll to the office, and then get back into construction as if nothing happened!
Hey everyone! Thank you so much for trying the demo :)
As it happens though when you put the game in hands of a lot of people many issues crop up, and we've noticed many players have reached soft-locks that do not let them advance in the story.
We did not encounter these bugs in our testing and thus have released an update that aims to fix that issue, but please let us know if it works for you or not!

If not, it would be really helpful if you can share your player.log file to debug the issue. You can find it in C:\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\Smarto Club\Bubblegum Galaxy , where is your windows username. Please send it to support@smarto.club.
EDIT: We got a couple of details wrong in the hot-fix, but we now uploaded v20230611b (note the b) which should fix the issue properly.
